priority.rule: Use for DLC identity, release status, headline included content and official feature descriptions.
Use for exhaustive enumeration and exact internal values when provenance is documented and reproducible.
Use for category membership, canonical naming and structured mission/reward coverage; preserve verification status.
Use for practical routes, mechanics confirmation and corroboration when primary data is unavailable.
Use primarily to discover missing coverage; never silently promote disputed claims to verified facts.

conflict_rule: When sources disagree, preserve each claim, record provenance and mark the field conflict until a higher-priority or independently corroborated source resolves it.
